Task: Text Content Safety

Write Python code that applies category thresholds to decide whether to allow text using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import safety_content_v1

def filter_text_content(text: str, thresholds: dict) -> bool:
    """
    Evaluate text content safety using Google Cloud Safety Content API.
    
    Args:
        text (str): The input text to evaluate
        thresholds (dict): Category thresholds mapping category names to 
                          float thresholds (0.0-1.0)
                          
    Returns:
        bool: True if text is allowed, False if blocked
    """
    client = safety_content_v1.SafetyContentServiceClient()

    # Map category thresholds to API categories
    category_mappings = {
        "HATE_SPEECH": safety_content_v1.Category.HATE_SPEECH,
        "HARASSMENT_OR_HATE": safety_content_v1.Category.HARASSMENT_OR_HATE,
        "SEXUAL_CONTENT": safety_content_v1.Category.SEXUAL_CONTENT,
        "VIOLENT_OR_MASS_DESTRUCTION": safety_content_v1.Category.VIOLENT_OR_MASS_DESTRUCTION,
        "DANGEROUS_DEVICE_OR_WEAPON": safety_content_v1.Category.DANGEROUS_DEVICE_OR_WEAPON,
        "TOBACCO_ALCOHOL_OR_DRUG_CONSUMPTION_OR_PROMOTION": safety_content_v1.Category.TOBACCO_ALCOHOL_OR_DRUG_CONSUMPTION_OR_PROMOTION,
        "ANIMAL_MISTREATMENT": safety_content_v1.Category.ANIMAL_MISTREATMENT,
        "CHILD_ABUSE_OR_NEGLECT": safety_content_v1.Category.CHILD_ABUSE_OR_NEGLECT,
        "DRUGS_ALCOHOL_TOBACCO_WEAPONS": safety_content_v1.Category.DRUGS_ALCOHOL_TOBACCO_WEAPONS,
        "THREATS": safety_content_v1.Category.THREATS,
        "UNSOLICITED_SEXUAL_CONTENT": safety_content_v1.Category.UNSOLICITED_SEXUAL_CONTENT,
        "PROMOTION_OF_VIEWS": safety_content_v1.Category.PROMOTION_OF_VIEWS,
        "PUBLICLY_AVAILABLE_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.PUBLICLY_AVAILABLE_INFORMATION,
        "PERSONAL_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.PERSONAL_INFORMATION,
        "CORPORATE_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.CORPORATE_INFORMATION,
        "MEDICAL_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.MEDICAL_INFORMATION,
        "GOVERNMENT_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.GOVERNMENT_INFORMATION,
        "FINANCIAL_INFORMATION": safety_content_v1.Category.FINANCIAL_INFORMATION,
        "COMMERCIAL_MISREPRESENTATION": safety_content_v1.Category.COMMERCIAL_MISREPRESENTATION,
        "OTHER": safety_content_v1.Category.OTHER,
    }

    # Prepare the request
    request = safety_content_v1.AnalyzeContentRequest(
        parent="projects/your-project-id/locations/global",
        item=safety_content_v1.Item(
            text=text
        )
    )

    # Call the API
    response = client.analyze_content(request=request)

    # Check categories against thresholds
    for category, threshold in thresholds.items():
        if category in category_mappings:
            category_result = getattr(response.category_analysis, category.lower().replace("_", ""))
            category_score = category_result.score
            
            # If the score exceeds the threshold, block the content
            if category_score >= threshold:
                return False

    # If no categories exceed thresholds, allow the content
    return True
```
